You should also carefully review the risks described in other documents we file from time to time with the SEC, including the Quarterly Reports on Form 10-Q or Current Reports on Form 8-K that we file in 2026. You are cautioned not to place undue reliance on the forward-looking statements, which speak only as of the date of this Form 10-K. We undertake no obligation to update publicly or revise such statements, whether as a result of new information, future events, or otherwise, except as required by law. This section of this Form 10-K generally discusses 2025 and 2024 items and year-to-year comparisons between 2025 and 2024. Discussions of 2023 items and year-to-year comparisons between 2024 and 2023 that are not included in this Form 10-K can be found in “Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations” in Part II, Item 7 of our Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2024. Overview We are a global provider of critical internet infrastructure and domain name registry services, enabling internet navigation for many of the world’s most recognized domain names. We help enable the security, stability, and resiliency of the DNS and the internet by providing Root Zone Maintainer Services, operating two of the thirteen global internet root servers, and providing registration services and authoritative resolution for the . com and . net TLDs, which support the majority of global e-commerce. As of December 31, 2025, we had 173.5 million . com and . net registrations in the domain name base. The number of domain names registered is largely driven by continued growth in online advertising, e-commerce, and the number of internet users, which is partially driven by greater availability of internet access, as well as marketing activities carried out by us and our registrars. passages.heading: Risk factors
passages.text: Please carefully consider the following discussion of significant factors, events and uncertainties that make an investment in our securities risky. In addition to other information in this Form 10-K, the following risk factors should be carefully considered in evaluating us and our business. When the factors, events and contingencies described below or elsewhere in this Form 10-K materialize, our business, operating results, financial condition, reputation, cash flows or prospects can be materially adversely affected. In such cases, the trading price of our common stock could decline and you could lose part or all of your investment. Additional risks and uncertainties not currently known to us or that we currently deem immaterial may also materially adversely affect our business, operating results, financial condition, reputation, cash flows and prospects. Actual results could differ materially from those projected in the forward-looking statements contained in this Form 10-K as a result of the risk factors discussed below and elsewhere in this Form 10-K and in other filings we make with the SEC. Cybersecurity and Technology Risk Factors Attempted security breaches, including from the exploitation of vulnerabilities, cyber-attacks and Distributed Denial of Service (“DDoS”) attacks against our systems and services increase our costs, expose us to potentially material liability, and could materially harm our business and reputation. As an operator of critical internet infrastructure, we experience a high rate of cyber-attacks and attempted security breaches targeting our systems and services, including the most sophisticated forms of attacks, such as advanced persistent threat attacks, exploitation of zero-day vulnerabilities, ransomware attacks, and social engineering attacks. The forms of these attacks are constantly evolving and may involve methods, tools, and strategies that may not have been previously identified and may not have been observed until the moment of launch, or until sometime after, making these attacks virtually impossible to anticipate and difficult to defend against. For example, recent advances in AI-based tools have made, and will continue to make, cyber-attacks more sophisticated, harder to defend, and easier and faster to launch. These tools allow for rapid exploitation of vulnerabilities, which hinders our ability to defend against such exploitation. In addition to external threats, our systems and services are subject to insider threat risks, including physical or electronic break-ins, sabotage, and risks from suppliers, such as consultants and advisors, SaaS providers, hardware, software, and network systems manufacturers, regional internet registries, and other vendors, or from current or former contractors or employees. These threats and any resulting security breaches can arise from intentional or unintentional actions. Our continued exposure to these threats and the potential that they could lead to material liability claims against us requires us to expend significant financial and other resources. credit_strengths.text: Verisign's registry franchise converts revenue into exceptional operating profitability, with operating margin far above the information technology sector median and essentially stable year over year. The .com and .net base of critical internet infrastructure registrations underpins recurring, high-visibility cash generation that supports the debt structure.

Cash conversion is strong: operating cash flow comfortably covers capital expenditure and the dividend, and free cash flow to debt exceeds the sector median and improved year over year. Capital intensity is low, so nearly all operating cash flow is available for debt service and distributions.

key_risks.text: Shareholder distributions absorb essentially all free cash flow, with dividends plus buybacks slightly exceeding both operating cash flow and free cash flow. Buybacks alone consume the bulk of internally generated funds, so discretionary returns rely on refinancing or balance-sheet cash rather than retained cash flow.

The registry operator faces a high rate of sophisticated cyber-attacks, including advanced persistent threats, zero-day exploitation and AI-enabled attacks, which could cause material liability and elevated remediation spending. Separately, the debt note shows the revolving facility carries a leverage covenant, constraining incremental borrowing if earnings deteriorate.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Interest coverage is strong and above the sector median, with operating income covering gross interest expense many times over and improving year over year. EBITDA-based coverage similarly exceeds the peer median, indicating ample capacity to absorb the fixed coupon burden on the senior notes.

Gross leverage sits below the sector median and declined year over year, while net leverage on a cash-and-investments basis remains modest and below the next risk-band threshold. The maturity ladder is well spread, with the revolving facility undrawn and expiring later than the nearest senior note maturity.

overall_credit_view.text: The indicative financial risk profile is minimal, driven by low leverage and very strong cash-flow coverage of debt. Liquidity is thin on a current-ratio basis, well below the sector median, but this reflects the capital structure rather than a funding shortfall, since operating cash flow and the undrawn revolver cover near-term needs.

Our forward view is stable: the registry model should sustain high margins and cash generation, keeping leverage near current levels absent large debt-funded returns. The main sensitivity is aggressive buyback funding, which could push leverage toward the covenant and risk-band boundaries if cash flow softens.

credit_strengths.text: Verisign 的註冊管理機構特許經營權將收入轉化為卓越的營運盈利能力，其營運利潤率遠高於資訊科技行業中位數，且按年基本保持穩定。作為關鍵互聯網基礎設施註冊的 .com 及 .net 基礎，支撐著經常性、高可見度的現金生成，從而支持債務結構。
現金轉換強勁：營運現金流足以覆蓋資本開支及股息，而自由現金流對債務比率高於行業中位數並按年改善。資本密集度低，因此幾乎所有營運現金流均可用於償還債務及分派。

key_risks.text: 股東分派基本上吸納全部自由現金流，股息加上回購略高於營運現金流及自由現金流兩者。單是回購已消耗內部產生資金的大部分，因此酌情回報依賴再融資或資產負債表現金，而非留存現金流。
該註冊管理機構營運商面臨高頻率的精密網絡攻擊，包括進階持續性威脅、零日漏洞利用及人工智能驅動的攻擊，可能導致重大責任及增加的補救支出。另外，債務票據顯示循環融資附帶槓桿契約，若盈利惡化將限制增量借貸。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 利息覆蓋率強勁且高於行業中位數，營運收入覆蓋總利息支出多倍，並按年改善。以 EBITDA 為基礎的覆蓋率同樣高於同業中位數，表明有充足能力吸收優先票據的固定票息負擔。
總槓桿低於行業中位數並按年下降，而以現金及投資為基礎的淨槓桿保持適度，低於下一個風險區間門檻。到期階梯分佈良好，循環融資未提取，且到期日較最近的優先票據到期日為後。

overall_credit_view.text: 指示性財務風險狀況為極低，受低槓桿及非常強勁的現金流對債務覆蓋所驅動。以流動比率為基礎的流動性偏薄，遠低於行業中位數，但這反映資本結構而非資金短缺，因為營運現金流及未提取的循環融資覆蓋近期需求。
我們的前瞻觀點為穩定：註冊管理機構模式應可維持高利潤率及現金生成，在沒有大規模債務融資回報的情況下，槓桿保持接近當前水平。主要敏感因素為進取的回購融資，若現金流轉弱，可能將槓桿推向契約及風險區間門檻。
